description: Get a regular duplicate or duplicate-by-post job by jobId. After ads_duplicate or ads_duplicate_by_post returns still_running, poll until complete is true. Inspect created, failed and skipped objects for copy jobs. A partial job has created objects: report newId and current name from created, plus stage and error.message from failed. retryable marks a saved retry; retry only the failed step from your Agent Inbox, or change the existing object in Ads Manager when unavailable. Never run the copy again; it would create a second copy. Pending approvals have no job until the user approves in your Agent Inbox.
name: ads_get_duplication
title: Get Duplication Status
